propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) have no test coverage exercising pagination beyond a single page despite paginating via opaque nextPageToken cursor.
The readers' pagination loop terminates on either isLast=True OR absent/null nextPageToken, but no test independently asserts both stop conditions or that cursor tokens advance across requests.
A repeated cursor token causes the readers to spin forever (byte-identical request → identical response → neither break fires), which fail-open exception handlers convert to silently partial maps.
Short page truncation bug (break-on-short-page, the DC bug class) transplanted into Cloud loop must be detectable by dedicated oracle distinct from count-based assertions.
Structural guard scans only DC transport source, leaving Cloud whole-project reader search callers unguarded against future non-paginated offenders.

Test module verifies all three readers recover 250 seeded items across 3 pages (250 at 100/page) with payload identity checks, cursor token advance asserted on request bodies, and isolated stop-condition oracles.
